title: Implement profile schema validation and migration rule
description:
Create ONLY Source/Profiles/ProfileSchema.h and Source/Profiles/ProfileSchema.cpp for the ShredSpace profile format.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.h and Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.cpp (frozen in phase b) for the authoritative parameter IDs, ranges, and defaults. Do NOT modify them.
- CMakeLists.txt (read only) to learn the include conventions and the JUCE module set already linked. Do NOT modify CMakeLists.txt in this task; task i.6 owns it.
- JUCE/modules/juce_core/juce_core.h for juce::var, juce::JSON, juce::DynamicObject. Never modify anything under JUCE/.

Define a plain data struct ProfileDocument holding exactly these fields parsed from JSON: schema_version (int), product_version (String), profile_name (String), author (String), description (String), base_parameter_values (map from parameter ID string to float), macro_mapping (per-macro list of destination entries: destination parameter ID, delta_min, delta_max, curve with curve > 0 and default 1.0), scene_values (four scenes A/B/C/D, each holding eight macro targets, a Mix target, a routing target, and a Hold behavior enum), and tags (StringArray).

Define ProfileValidationResult carrying an ok flag, a list of human-readable errors, and a list of migration notes. Implement ProfileSchema::parse(const juce::var&) returning ProfileDocument plus ProfileValidationResult, and ProfileSchema::validate(const ProfileDocument&).

Binding validation rules to implement exactly:
1. kCurrentSchemaVersion = 1. A document whose schema_version is missing, non-integer, less than 1, or greater than kCurrentSchemaVersion is rejected (ok == false).
2. Every parameter ID referenced by base_parameter_values, by any macro_mapping destination, and by any scene routing/Mix target must exist in the frozen parameter layout. Existence is checked by querying the parameter layout ID list passed in as a const juce::StringArray& argument; ProfileSchema must not construct an AudioProcessorValueTreeState itself.
3. Migration rule for unknown IDs: an unknown parameter ID is DROPPED from the parsed document, is NOT an error, and appends one migration note of the form "dropped unknown parameter id: <id>"; the document remains ok. An unknown ID that would leave a macro with zero destinations drops that macro's mapping to an empty table (still ok).
4. Malformed input (non-object root, non-numeric where numeric is required, curve <= 0, delta_min/delta_max not finite, fewer or more than four scenes, fewer or more than eight macro entries when macro_mapping is present) must fail safely: return ok == false with a non-empty error list and a default-constructed ProfileDocument. Never throw, never assert, never partially publish.
5. All values loaded into base_parameter_values are clamped to the frozen parameter range for that ID before being stored.
6. Nothing in this file may be called from the audio thread; do not add any real-time entry points, and do not allocate on behalf of an audio-thread caller.

The eight macro names are exactly TIME, SPACE, DEFINITION, BLOOM, TAIL, FOCUS, WIDTH, CHARACTER, in that order, exposed as a constexpr array kMacroNames.

No artist or song name may appear in any comment, string, or identifier.
acceptance_criteria: Source/Profiles/ProfileSchema.h and Source/Profiles/ProfileSchema.cpp exist and declare ProfileDocument, ProfileValidationResult, ProfileSchema::parse, ProfileSchema::validate, kCurrentSchemaVersion, and kMacroNames
kCurrentSchemaVersion is defined and a schema_version outside [1, kCurrentSchemaVersion] returns ok == false
An unknown parameter ID is dropped and recorded as a migration note without setting ok to false
Malformed input returns ok == false with a non-empty error list and a default-constructed ProfileDocument, with no throw and no assert
kMacroNames contains exactly TIME, SPACE, DEFINITION, BLOOM, TAIL, FOCUS, WIDTH, CHARACTER in that order
No artist or song name appears in either file
No file outside this task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: add Catch2, GoogleTest, or any non-juce::UnitTest test framework
add file IO or JSON parsing entry points intended for the audio thread
include artist or song names in comments, strings, or identifiers

allowed: choose internal container types for the parsed document
choose error message wording within the specified formats
add local static helpers inside ProfileSchema.cpp
forbidden: change the frozen parameter layout or its IDs
define the real-time snapshot format here
perform file IO in this module
